description: ValeVision Gallery app settings. Projects come from the Projects Master Library through the Gallery API (api/projects); this file holds only app settings and option lists.
vale__MyProjects__Note: My Projects: Designer and Concept Artist accounts open the gallery on the projects naming them as designer or concept artist, matched on the account's first name. List an account here (USR code: the name on its projects) when its projects carry another name.
